odoo_app: Custom (closest: Odoo has no anonymous-visitor scoring app; benchmarked against generic marketing-automation lead scoring)

capabilities.name: Rule-based behavioral scoring (return visits, pricing interest, deep engagement, reawakening)
capabilities.verify: score_visitor_intent skill (src/lib/modules/visitor-intelligence-module.ts) evaluates site_settings.visitor_intelligence_rules and writes visitor_signals + bumps lead.score; UI at src/pages/admin/VisitorIntelligencePage.tsx manages session_count/url_visits/page_view_count/reawakening rules and notification email.
capabilities.notes: Odoo has no anonymous-visitor identity-stitching/scoring app; this is a FlowWink differentiator.

capabilities.name: Per-lead behavioral timeline (page views + fired signals)
capabilities.verify: get_visitor_timeline skill (db:page_views handler) + VisitorTimelineWidget.tsx rendered in CRM lead detail.

capabilities.name: Automated recurring scoring run
capabilities.verify: AutomationSeed 'Score visitor intent (every 15 min)' in visitor-intelligence-module.ts, trigger_type cron, dispatched via automation-dispatcher; adjustable in /admin/automations.

capabilities.name: Anonymous-to-identified visitor stitching
capabilities.verify: Module doc states 'identity stitching' as a feature but no dedicated skill/UI surfaces the stitching logic itself — only downstream scoring (score_visitor_intent) and timeline (get_visitor_timeline) are exposed.
capabilities.notes: Stitching appears to happen implicitly inside page_views/lead matching; no explicit admin control or skill to inspect/adjust match confidence.

capabilities.name: Live/active visitor session monitoring
capabilities.verify: VisitorSessionsTab.tsx exists under src/components/admin/chat/ but is filed under the Chat/Live-support admin surface, not surfaced as a Visitor Intelligence skill (no MCP tool lists active sessions).
capabilities.notes: UI-only; no skillSeed exposes 'who is on the site right now' over MCP.

capabilities.name: Admin-configurable rule builder (add/edit/disable individual rules)
capabilities.verify: VisitorIntelligencePage.tsx reads/writes site_settings.visitor_intelligence_rules with per-rule threshold and enable toggles.

capabilities.name: Score decay / time-based cooldown so stale signals don't inflate score forever
capabilities.verify: score_visitor_intent instructions only mention 'won't double-fire the same day per lead'; no decay/expiry logic found in module or docs.
capabilities.notes: Scores can accumulate indefinitely with no observed decay mechanism.

capabilities.name: Trigger CRM actions (create task, notify rep) directly from a fired signal
capabilities.verify: Rules support a notification email (per VisitorIntelligencePage), but no skill creates a CRM task/deal-stage-move directly from a signal — would need chaining through the separate automations module.
capabilities.notes: Only email notification is built-in; deeper CRM workflow actions require manual automation wiring.
